headline: City win Manchester derby in controversial fashion
description: Despite going down to 10-men, Manchester City scored the match winner through Erling Haaland as the Citizens hold off Manchester United to take the 1-0 win.

headline: Premier League referees' body apologizes to Man United after derby offside controversy
description: Pro Ref, the Premier League referees' body, has apologized to Manchester United after admitting the VAR awarded Erling Haaland's winning goal in Manchester City's 1-0 win by "error."

headline: Micah Richards: Manchester derby a 'bad day for referees' after Phil Foden red, Erling Haaland winner
description: Micah Richards said the Manchester derby was a "bad day for referees" after City claimed a 1-0 win with a controversial goal.
